title: dependency_after_save
description: Event: a #[Cacheable] value resource declared a dependency with CacheDependencyInterface::depends() outside its own put, usually from a template helper while the page renders. The value and its ETag are stored before rendering, so the child's tags reach the response's Surrogate-Key only: a change to the child does not invalidate the entry, and the old ETag keeps answering 304. Only recorded; a page that reads children while rendering should cache its rendered output with #[CacheableResponse] or #[Cacheable(type: 'view')]. Follows the `depends_on` for the same edge.
